high_value_findings.finding: Cross-platform portability emerged as a concrete runtime substrate: systemd assumptions were replaced inside containers, CPU/CUDA/Vulkan builds were separated, and repeated dependency/link failures hardened native and container installation paths.
high_value_findings.transfer: Treat portability as executable architecture with backend-specific build/runtime tests, not as README capability wording.

high_value_findings.finding: Prebuilt artifacts became a release channel through GHCR and CI, with OCI source metadata and explicit package write permissions.
high_value_findings.transfer: FRANK releases should bind artifact identity to source revision, backend, checksums/SBOM and reproducible build provenance before promotion.

high_value_findings.finding: The AURA UI mixed backend-derived captions with a 10Hz local GoL simulation between slower backend polls for visual fluidity.
high_value_findings.transfer: Observability UIs must label measured state versus interpolated/simulated presentation so visual smoothness cannot be mistaken for higher-frequency cognitive evidence.

high_value_findings.finding: Conversation memory moved from character truncation to asynchronous recursive abstraction, then added explicit caps, merges and archival to prevent unbounded live-context growth.
high_value_findings.transfer: ClayGraph/UnifiedDB memory should preserve bounded active context while retaining reversible provenance links from compressed packets to exact source records.

high_value_findings.finding: Tier-2 blocks were deleted after Tier-3 distillation and old message text was replaced with an archive marker while relying on other indexes/embeddings/abstractions for retained access.
high_value_findings.transfer: Before adopting destructive/subsuming compression, verify source recoverability independently; compression must never be the sole surviving representation of evidence.

negative_results_preserved: Vulkan builds were incomplete without development headers and glslc.
Container builds required dbus-python compiler dependencies and CUDA stub linking that were absent initially.
Documentation-only claims such as deployment recommendations, version labels, recovery links and component listings were explicitly not promoted to runtime evidence.
AURA presentation included locally simulated/interpolated evolution between backend measurements, so display dynamics are not direct measurement cadence.
Recursive memory compression introduced provenance/recoverability risk when lower-level abstractions or message text were removed after distillation.
epistemic_boundary: README claims of emergent personality/consciousness and release capabilities are retained as historical context only unless supported by code/runtime evidence. This shard establishes mechanisms present in the diffs, not current runtime behavior at the frozen head unless separately corroborated.

earned_work.reason: No row-level conceptual dedup against the earned-work ledger was performed.

next_falsifiers: Build CPU/CUDA/Vulkan images from pinned source on clean runners and verify runtime health, model loading and artifact provenance/SBOM.
Compare AURA backend snapshots with displayed/interpolated frames and assert UI labels prevent simulated frames from entering measurement datasets.
Stress RAE memory beyond Tier-3 caps and verify exact source-message reconstruction or durable immutable provenance refs after pruning/archival.
Kill the Micro-LLM during consolidation and verify fallback preserves semantic coverage without blocking chat or corrupting abstraction lineage.
Run container/native fault injection for missing Vulkan headers, CUDA stubs, dbus build deps and process-manager service failure.
